description: The Astro Diary helps people explore current and upcoming planetary and lunar conditions, retrieve charts for saved profiles, compare synastry with composite relationship charts, review chart-derived relationship transits, personal transits and returns, and find reflective timing windows. Public sky tools work without an account, while personalized tools use OAuth and enforce profile ownership.

defaultPrompt: Show me today’s planetary sky and the Moon forecast for the next seven days.
For my saved profile, summarize my natal chart, current transits, and upcoming astrology events.
Compare two of my saved profiles using synastry and a composite chart, without compatibility scores or predictions.
